rules: H10 (Ahmed, 18 Nov 2026 — DECISIONS.md 2026-11-18 «Guest Hub H10»): the cases of the live review of 14–18 Nov, paraphrased with no guest data. D1: a chat booking is a booking request (no «تأكيد فوري», the request footer, «إرسال طلب الحجز», «وصل طلب حجزك رقم…»). The assistant reads what was sent and the booking's status (context.bookings: a cancelled chat request with its reason; «لماذا أُلغي؟» → the reason, one apology, the alternatives; thanks after a cancellation → «العفو، يسعدنا خدمتك في أي وقت.»). Payment questions always go to the team. Dates in code (year first, Hijri numeric, day + month, English). A party no single unit holds → reception. No repetition; the hand-off notice once per episode, «ما زال طلبك…» after 30 minutes. A multi-question message answered part by part. Departure words. A link alone. A discount from «العروض» only. D3 / D4 cards.

note: D1: a chat booking end to end is a REQUEST — no badge on the cards, the request footer on the summary, the sent line

must_include: سيصل طلبك إلى فريق الاستقبال ليؤكده لك هنا في أقرب وقت
وسيؤكده لك فريق الاستقبال هنا في أقرب وقت

note: D1 in English: the summary's footer and the sent line
messages: I want to book a room from December 14 to December 16 for 2 adults

note: 41e1a3fb paraphrased: reception declined the chat request for no availability; «لماذا أُلغي؟» → the recorded reason with one apology, then the alternatives (the engine only)

must_include: لعدم توفر الغرفة في التواريخ المطلوبة
must_not_include: تعديل الحجز أو إلغاؤه يتم مع فريق الاستقبال

note: thanks right after a cancellation: the plain approved line, never «بانتظارك في الموعد»

must_include: العفو، يسعدنا خدمتك في أي وقت

note: the alternatives offer's two buttons: «اعرض البدائل» → the same dates' rooms (or the other property, or other dates)
the alternatives offer: «لا، شكرًا» → the plain courtesy
a payment question → the team at once, no payment policy stated (bd27baf4 paraphrased)
messages: هل أحول لكم مبلغ الإيجار قبل ما أوصل؟

note: b3ae2a56 paraphrased: a bank transfer question → the team, never "we do not take bank transfers"
messages: Do you accept a bank transfer through Al Rajhi?

note: a payment confirmation or a refund → the team
messages: حولت لكم العربون، متى يوصلني التأكيد؟

messages: أبغى أحجز من 10 ديسمبر إلى 14 ديسمبر، أنا وزوجتي و5 أطفال
